overview.description: The Defiance AI Magnificent 10 ETF (AIMG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the BITA AI Magnificent 10 Select index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted narrow index of companies operating across the AI value chain. Securities may include common stock, including from foreign companies, and depositary receipts. AIMG was launched on Sep 9, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
